# 4ARKS

> 4ARKS is a custom software company that builds AI-powered business systems from scratch.
> We replace SaaS subscriptions with owned, custom-built software — giving businesses
> permanent ownership of their tools instead of paying recurring platform fees forever.

## Who We Are

4ARKS is a global, remote-first custom software company. We work with businesses across
industries to build the software they need — tailored exactly to their processes, deployed
to their own infrastructure, and fully owned by them after delivery.

We are not a SaaS company. We do not sell subscriptions. We build and hand over.

Our core belief: businesses should own the software that runs their operations, not rent it
from platforms that raise prices, add limits, and hold data hostage.

## What We Build

### AI CRM
Custom CRM systems powered by AI. Replaces HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive.
Built around the client's exact sales process. AI lead scoring, automated follow-ups,
call summaries, unified inbox, unlimited seats. Full code ownership on delivery.
URL: https://fourarks.live/services/ai-crm

### WhatsApp & Call Automation
Custom AI agents on WhatsApp Business API and phone. Replaces Wati, Interakt, AiSensy,
Yellow.ai, Exotel. No per-conversation fees. 24/7 lead qualification, booking, FAQ
handling, and escalation. Client owns all data and the system.
URL: https://fourarks.live/services/whatsapp-call-automation

### Workflow Automation
Self-hosted workflow automation (n8n, open-source) on the client's own server.
Replaces Zapier, Make.com, n8n Cloud. No task limits. No usage billing.
URL: https://fourarks.live/services/workflow-automation

### Website Development
Custom React / Next.js websites. Replaces Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, WordPress.
Client owns the full codebase. Core Web Vitals 90+. No platform subscription after delivery.
URL: https://fourarks.live/services/website-development

### Branding & Design
Complete brand identity — logo, colour palette, typography, Figma design system,
social templates, pitch deck. All files owned by client. No Canva or Adobe CC needed.
URL: https://fourarks.live/services/branding-design

## Core Positioning

The SaaS model charges businesses for software they never own. 4ARKS's alternative:
pay once to build the system, own it forever. Runs on client infrastructure. Any
developer can extend it. Zero dependency on 4ARKS after handover.

## Technology Stack

React 18, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Python, Supabase (PostgreSQL),
OpenAI API, Anthropic API, LangChain, n8n, WhatsApp Business API, Vercel, Railway.

## Open Roles

Web Developer · AI/ML Engineer · AI Expert · Marketing & Sponsorship ·
Video Editor · Social Media Manager — all fully remote.

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- Business model: Project-based. One-time build fee. Full ownership transfer on delivery.
- NOT a SaaS company, NOT an agency, NOT a no-code tool reseller.
- Clients own all code, data, and credentials after handover.
- SaaS tools replaced: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Wati, Interakt, Zapier, Make.com,
  Webflow, Wix, WordPress, Canva Pro, Adobe CC, Yellow.ai, Exotel, Pipedrive, Freshsales.
